children.value: > Fact From Story | Fortnite maker Epic Games is still set to go to trial with the tech giant today, November 6, in hopes of convincing a jury that Google engages in anticompetitive behavior with regard to its Android app store, Google Play, and its commission structure.
> > Fact From Story | Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax”
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Monopolies can engage in anticompetitive behavior.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Antitrust laws are designed to prevent anticompetitive behavior.
